status: Protocol-continuity assumptions applied to missing settings; no scientific acceptance implied.
authority: User-directed interpretation: unchanged settings may carry forward within the applicable experimental sequence until a recorded change or exception.
provenance_policy: provenance.json is unchanged original transcription evidence. Applications are the current field-resolution overlay for their enumerated target cells only. Original source_record/raw tokens, delivered-quantity evidence, QA warnings and analysis_ready are not altered. Applications without source_commit were applied relative to the top-level source_commit; later applications state their own pre-edit source_commit. Each group expands to one audit entry per target_record_id and field. Retained-note and method-period assumptions may resolve fields absent from the donor CSV; their evidence and basis are explicit.
application_policy: Use finite reviewed target lists within named delivery/method periods or a documented calibration-series continuation; no automatic fill for future records.
Explicit values and exceptions take precedence; change only blank setting cells.
Separate physical delivery form, calculation method, stock solvent, receiving water and observed/fitted quantities.
Dose continuity can outlast a calibration-recipe change. A mass-based calculation does not imply dry physical delivery.
Method-period classification may use a later corroborating recipe, explicitly labelled retrospective; it is not direct observation or forward-only inheritance.
A shared standard may extend across samples in one documented calibration series without changing site or probe identity or reusing a fitted factor.
Nominal stock-water volume may be resolved from retained volume wording; never silently convert water mass to volume or initial water to final solution.
Preserve all scientific review states, delivery/mixing exceptions, source evidence and measurements.
